MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 7

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 13

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

15. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
